messages.title: Professorship for Neurosciences in Human Movement Studies
messages.body_html:
The Faculty of Economics and Behavioral Sciences of the University of Freiburg in Germany invites applications for a Professorship (W3) for Neurosciences in Human Movement Studies in the Department of Sport Science and Physical Education.

The Professor will concentrate on neurophysiological aspects of human motor control and learning. A sports-related expertise in human movement science is expected. In addition, the candidate needs to demonstrate a profound expertise in human-neurophysiology.

The official announcement with all its details is attached and can as well be found at: https://www.uni-freiburg.de/verwaltung/stellenboerse/00000917

Deadline for application is 2020-03-20.
 
 
Best regards,
 
Dominic Gehring
 
 
 
Institut für Sport und Sportwissenschaft

PD Dr. Dominic Gehring

Schwarzwaldstr. 175
79117 Freiburg i. Br.
 
Tel.     +49 / (0)761/ 203-4521
Email: mailto:EMAIL_REDACTED
Internetseite: www.sport.uni-freiburg.de

messages.author: Stewart Heitmann
messages.title: Modellers Workshop for the Brain Dynamics Toolbox, Mar 1-20 2020.
messages.body_html:
Modeller’s Workshop for the Brain Dynamics Toolbox
Online Course
Mar 1-20, 2020 

The Brain Dynamics Toolbox is an open toolbox for simulating dynamical systems in neuroscience. This on-line course is for researchers, students and instructors who wish to use the toolbox to build their own dynamical models. Participants learn the art of programming differential equations in Matlab and how to use the toolbox to solve those equations interactively. Topics include programming Ordinary Differential Equations, Partial Differential Equations, Delay Differential Equations, Stochastic Differential Equations, Auxiliary Plot Functions and command-line tools. Example code is provided in all cases. 

Course Website
https://bdtoolbox.org/p/modellers-workshop/ 

Important Dates 
Early-bird enrolments ($100) close Sunday 8th March, 2020. 
Late enrolments ($125) close Friday 20th March, 2020.
